name: mirage
text: Yes, that's how I built it. After a report is saved to GitHub, the phone clears its logs back to empty, only after the save succeeds. If the save fails, the logs are kept. Your bets, settings, keys and scan study are not touched. Each hourly report is also kept on GitHub, so nothing is lost. It lands in version 1.0.76, right after 1.0.75 finishes building. I'll send you the link.
